page: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor with 2 vCPUs, derived from 1 physical core and 2 threads per core. The CPU operates at a clock speed of 4.2 GHz and includes a 480 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and includes 118 GB of local SSD storage with support for Premium Storage.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core scoring 2268.08 and single-threaded gzip compression reaching 30.79 GB/sec. However, multi-core and memory performance are more limited. The stress-ng multi-core score is 2300.17, and memory bandwidth write speeds for large blocks are measured at 11.86 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET benchmarks also sit in the lower tiers, with Redis managing 4.06 million operations per second.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a balanced resource profile for entry-level workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation and local storage without demanding high multi-threaded throughput. It is suitable for lightweight web serving, basic database operations, development environments, and low-intensity background tasks.
